jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE complete, closed treasure chest sprite for a hand-painted 2D isometric mobile dungeon game, on genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Design: a squat, substantial medieval treasure chest with a gently rounded barrel lid, dark warm walnut wooden panels, two broad worn golden-brass reinforcement straps wrapping over the lid, thick beveled corner fittings and one large central golden latch with a simple dark keyhole. The latch and two straps are the main readable landmarks. Rich but restrained design, with a few large wood shapes and broad painted highlights. No tiny filigree, no proliferation of rivets. Slightly sinister fantasy dungeon mood, without skulls, teeth, eyes or mimic features. No magical glow or purple jewels for this basic chest.
CAMERA IS CRITICAL: use orthographic 2:1 game dimetric projection, as if elevated about 30 degrees above the ground and rotated 45 degrees horizontally. The ground-aligned straight edges form diagonals with exactly 2 horizontal units for 1 vertical unit in the image (slopes plus and minus 0.5). All verticals remain vertical; all parallel edges remain parallel. Show lid, broad front face and one short side. It must sit on the same diamond grid as a top-down isometric stone dungeon, not a frontal chest icon, not a near-eye-level perspective drawing, not a 3D perspective render. A rectangular footprint about 1.4 times as wide as deep, low chunky body, flat grounded bottom without long feet.
Style: polished illustrated game sprite, matching a dungeon of quiet slate-blue stones with softly rounded edges, purple magical props and black/gold interface. Hand-painted cartoon fantasy, clear faceted colour masses, dark navy contours, controlled golden highlights and warm brown wood. No photorealistic wood grain, surface noise, realism, high-frequency cracks or lens effects. Aim for strong readability at about 96 pixels wide in actual gameplay. Lighting from upper left, darker right side, with cool navy shaded edges to sit naturally among blue-gray stones. Gold should read clearly at small size without looking emissive.
Composition: exactly ONE isolated chest, closed lid, full object visible with transparent padding on all sides. Center the object and use most of a square canvas. No floor tile, no pedestal, no carpet, no coins outside, no extra props, no cast/drop shadow or haze outside the object, no text, labels, border, watermark, checkerboard or background colour. Preserve true native transparency.
